summary: Changes required. (1) runner.go writes the OpenRouter trace identity as provider-level samplingParams in models.json, but the pinned Pi harness 0.84.1 only reads samplingParams from per-model definitions or modelOverrides; provider-level samplingParams is ignored, so the claimed per-request trace metadata is never sent (direct composeModelProvider check shows composed models keep samplingParams undefined). (2) evals/run-model.sh invokes the exporter with system python3, while langfuse is declared only as an optional uv dependency and `uv sync --locked` does not install extras; with LANGFUSE_* keys set the exporter still writes a retryable outbox saying 'langfuse is not installed' and performs no export. Both defects are introduced by this Revision and leave the documented trace-metadata/export behavior as a silent no-op.
